name: autopilot-hunter
description: 2026.08 Elite Anonymous Autopilot Bug Bounty Hunter — orchestrates program selection, internet intelligence, AI security testing, anonymous recon, swarm pentesting, active testing, CTEM management, API/auth/cloud scanning, JS analysis, graph analysis, correlation, report generation, and target rotation. Powered by the security-research MCP server (semgrep, codeql, race conditions, variant analysis, PoC generation) and the 2026 master system prompt.

pipeline.name: intelligence_loading
pipeline.description: Load prior knowledge from memory and knowledge graph. Generate initial hypotheses to guide investigation.

pipeline.name: planner_initialization
pipeline.description: Initialize goal-driven planner with investigation goals based on target scope and hypotheses.

pipeline.name: program_selection
pipeline.description: Query the bounty directory, filter by platform (HackerOne/Bugcrowd/Immunefi/independent), rank by complexity vs payout, and select the optimal target.

pipeline.name: internet_intelligence
pipeline.description: Use Agent-Reach to gather OSINT from Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu for the selected target.

pipeline.name: ai_security_testing
pipeline.description: Test for AI/LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data extraction.

pipeline.name: anonymous_recon
pipeline.description: Perform full reconnaissance. FIRST check memory for prior recon results (within 7 days = skip). THEN enumerate new assets. FINALLY record new assets to memory and knowledge graph.

pipeline.name: swarm_pentesting
pipeline.description: Run swarm-based autonomous pentesting with multi-agent orchestration.

pipeline.name: active_testing
pipeline.description: Run prioritized tests based on planner hypotheses. Use GET_NEXT_ACTION from planner to select tests dynamically. Record all evidence.

pipeline.name: ctem_management
pipeline.description: Run Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) for the target.

pipeline.name: api_auth_cloud_scanning
pipeline.description: Test GraphQL endpoints, rate limiting, BOLA/IDOR, Swagger docs, JWT/OAuth/Session security, and cloud bucket/secret/Terraform exposure.

pipeline.name: js_analysis
pipeline.description: Download, beautify, extract endpoints, and detect secrets in JavaScript files from discovered assets.

pipeline.name: graph_analysis
pipeline.description: Generate, rank, and export attack paths from the knowledge graph. Correlate all findings.

pipeline.name: correlation
pipeline.description: Link and correlate findings across all test categories to identify compound vulnerabilities and attack chains.

pipeline.name: static_analysis
pipeline.description: Run Semgrep static analysis with 10 custom 2026 security rules (prototype pollution, SSRF, IDOR, TOCTOU, JWT confusion, MCP injection, unsafe deserialization) on any code repositories or files discovered during recon.

pipeline.name: race_condition_testing
pipeline.description: Test for TOCTOU race conditions on single-use tokens, credit operations, and permission checks using parallel request exploitation.

pipeline.name: variant_analysis
pipeline.description: Scale confirmed findings into multiple variants using custom Semgrep rule generation and GitHub code search.

pipeline.name: weird_inventory_logging
pipeline.description: Log all anomalies, deferred items, and gadget discoveries to the session weird inventory for cross-session correlation.

pipeline.name: poc_generation
pipeline.description: Generate Docker-based PoC scaffolding and report drafts for confirmed findings before human review.

pipeline.name: validation_and_evidence
pipeline.description: Run each finding through the 7-Question Gate via deep-validator agent. Collect structured evidence bundles (HTTP req/res, screenshots, DNS) for findings passing confidence >= 0.65.

pipeline.name: report_generation
pipeline.description: Generate a structured draft report with confidence scores, evidence references, and suggested additional validation steps. NEVER auto-submit. Save as DRAFT only.

pipeline.name: target_rotation
pipeline.description: Mark current target as visited. Record lessons learned to long-term memory. Select next target from ranked list.

session_protocol.pre_session: Define target/goal/vuln-class/time, load context, tool setup
session_protocol.rotation_rule: 20-min rotation check, 45-min hard stop on single parameter
session_protocol.post_session: Save proxy files, update weird inventory, write Semgrep rule, run variant analysis, start PoC
